name: nginx
description: The official NGINX Open Source repository.
one_liner: The web server software that quietly runs a huge share of the websites on the internet, routing traffic and serving pages reliably at scale.
buyer: Honestly, nobody buys 'nginx' itself — the real opportunity is in services around it, like hosting and managed configuration, not the software.
business_use_cases: A freelance DevOps consultant offers nginx configuration, hardening, and performance-tuning as a paid service for small businesses' websites.
A hosting reseller bundles pre-configured, secured nginx setups into a managed website-hosting package.
An agency builds reverse-proxy and load-balancing setups for clients migrating off expensive managed cloud services.

money_ideas.idea: One-off server setup and hardening consulting gigs
A monthly managed-hosting retainer that includes nginx maintenance

steal_this: Offer a flat-fee 'secure your website's server in a day' service to five local businesses this week.
